data.narrative:
Orbital Sidekick is a Series C-stage space and aerospace company that has raised $47.5M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 6 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private peers (Sierra Space, Apex Space, Cowboy Space Corporation, Varda Space Industries, and Aalyria among them) with disclosed valuations ranging from $1.15B to $8.0B, as well as 5 public space and aerospace comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two triangulation methods prove applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised ($47.5M) as a proxy for current value and applying a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, implies a valuation of $81M. The peer-median method, anchored to the $1.8B median across the 6-company private comp set, suggests $1.8B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied absent disclosure of the target's revenue. These two methods generate a low-to-high range of $69M to $2.1B, with a blended median of $935M.

The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around Orbital Sidekick's revenue traction, unit economics, and near-term growth trajectory relative to peers. Stage-progression implies a more conservative near-term valuation; peer-median reflects sector-wide valuations at a later stage of maturity. A narrower range would require disclosure of revenue or forward ARR metrics.
